description: This Java source file defines the 'RequestReceiver' class which manages a server socket to listen for and handle incoming requests on a specified port. It includes inner class 'ReceiverThread' to run the listening loop, deserialize requests using Jackson, and execute received requests.

classes.name: RequestReceiver
classes.description: Manages a server socket to accept incoming requests and handles starting/stopping the listening thread.

classes.name: ReceiverThread
classes.description: Inner class extending Thread that runs the request listening loop, deserializes requests, sends responses, and executes requests.

methods.name: RequestReceiver
methods.description: Constructor initializing the receiver with the specified port number.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the server socket and the listening thread.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the listening thread and closes the server socket.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main loop of the ReceiverThread that accepts connections, reads, deserializes, responds, and executes requests.
